# Balmond Clear Route Overcommit

His biggest mistake is turning a healthy clear into a low-value chase that misses the next lane crash.

## What to watch

- Abort pursuit when it costs the next objective setup.
- Route toward the lane that can actually convert your presence.
- Let the threat of execute move the map for you.

## Why it matters

The clean Balmond line is simple: finish camps, appear on time, and make the enemy solve a bad corridor.

> His power is tempo with armor on it, not freestyle pursuit.

More on Balmond: keep this read connected to fighter jungle structures, not just isolated mechanics.
